## Checklist

- [ ] Tests added or updated (`python -m pytest`)
- [ ] `ruff check .`, `ruff format --check .` and `mypy` pass
- [ ] No new network calls, telemetry or paid services; no `shell=True`
- [ ] No secrets in code, tests, fixtures or output
- [ ] CHANGELOG.md updated (under "Unreleased") if users will notice the change
